newsitem.title: USA: PolyMedica sees $0.21 EPS in fiscal '97.
newsitem.headline: PolyMedica sees $0.21 EPS in fiscal '97.

text.p: PolyMedica Industries Inc said on Tuesday it foresaw earnings per share of $0.21 in fiscal 1997 and of $0.43 in fiscal 1998.
In a statement, the company said it had set targets of net income growth of more than 100 percent and revenue growth of 60 percent for its next fiscal year, ending March 31, 1998.

"In the current fiscal year ending March 31, 1997, revenues are targeted to grow by 20 percent to approximately $30 million and are expected to generate net income of $1.7 million," the statement said.
"If achieved, these earnings would equal $0.43 and $0.21 per share in fiscal 1998 and 1997, respectively, based on current weighted average common shares outstanding."
The company reported third quarter income on Monday of $411,000, or $0.05 a share, against $743,000, or $0.10 a share, in the same period the year before.
